adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `else` branch for destinations without `credentialId` does `this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and then `createEvent(c, event)` for each match. `this.calendarCredentials` is the EventManager’s credential set (i.e., the organizer/context credentials), so a destination calendar entry representing another host (e.g., collective team member) that lacks `credentialId` will not target that host’s calendar; instead it will create one event per matching organizer credential of that integration type (potential duplicates and wrong calendar). This matches the finding and is directly verifiable from the diff logic.
